say:1:1041551401:0.text: Ha! Look at this place—lit up like a bonfire party! So much chaos, so much life!
say:1:1041551401:0.source_cn: 啊——这里亮堂了不少，而且真够热闹的！

say:2:1041551402:0.text: Fitting, isn't it? Emberlight—the humans' grand commemoration of their first tango with the ancient gods.
say:2:1041551402:0.source_cn: 正是春焰庆的时候——庆贺人类第一次直面古老神明的节日。

say:3:1041551403:1.text: Those towering beasts descended, and the mortals, desperate and crafty, mimicked their movements, throwing fireworks and noise into the fray.
say:3:1041551403:1.source_cn: 巨大的怪兽降临世间，人类模仿着它的姿态，以焰火与声响将...

say:4:1041551404:1.text: It's hilarious! Just thinking about it makes me laugh uncontrollably!
say:4:1041551404:1.source_cn: 没错，没错，那可太有趣了！光是想想都让我笑得停不下来！

say:5:1041551405:1.text: That big bad beast, acting all high and mighty, outwitted by these scurrying little mortals!
say:5:1041551405:1.source_cn: 可怜的大家伙，装模作样了那么久，却被凡人这种小东西耍得...

say:6:1041551406:1.text: Not only did it lose its stomping grounds, but it also earned itself a punchline for all eternity! HA!
say:6:1041551406:1.source_cn: 不仅离开了自己的地盘，还从此成为了流传已久的笑话！

say:7:1041551407:1.text: Hmm... Maybe the mortals had a silent hand guiding their moves. A rival god, perhaps?
say:7:1041551407:1.source_cn: 但，或许是那所谓的怪兽在自己的同伴中亦有敌人，或许是那...

say:8:1041551408:1.text: After all, to challenge gods, you often need a god of your own to pull the strings.
say:8:1041551408:1.source_cn: 想要与神比肩，自然需要先有一个引导其方向的神明。

say:9:1041551409:1.text: Otherwise, tales like this end up like smoke—twisting, drifting, never quite solid.
say:9:1041551409:1.source_cn: 否则，一切的努力都会像是我们正在谈论的，不知是历史还是...

say:10:1041551410:1.text: Pfft! Don't play coy, Phraesto—I know you love these jumbled-up, half-true messes as much as I do!
say:10:1041551410:1.source_cn: 啊——别说得好像你不喜欢这种模棱两可的囫囵故事一样！

say:11:1041551411:1.text: I'm hooked on the thrill, the chaos, the sheer absurdity of it all!
say:11:1041551411:1.source_cn: 我有多沉迷那些稀奇古怪的乐子，你就有多中意这些打着谜语...

say:12:1041551412:1.text: So why waste time unraveling it? Come on, let's dive in and soak up every twisted drop of this insanity!
say:12:1041551412:1.source_cn: 既然已经到了这会儿，就放弃思考，尽情地沉沦于欢乐当中吧！
